crossRefs.note: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Uzzah
people.line: Died while moving the ark; place named after him

translations.web: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah, to this day.
translations.bsb: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
translations.kjv: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.
translations.asv: And David was displeased, because Jehovah had broken forth upon Uzzah; and he called that place Perez-uzzah, unto this day.
